items.difficulty_reason: The lemma classifies ideals of a two-dimensional regular local ring with reduced or depth-one quotient (statement lines 4034-4041). The proof (lines 4043-4069) is complete: the UFD gcd factorization with the height-one exclusion and the dimension-2 dichotomy, the radical case concluding I = m or I = (f), and the depth-one case killing the class of f via non-associativity of m. Every step is present with no omissions. H2: a compact local-algebra classification with correctly ordered steps.
